item.title: Stella Lefty Talks Freaking Out About ‘Boston’ Reaching No. 3 On the Hot 100 & What to Expect From ‘Long Way Home’ Album | Billboard News
item.description:
[Intro music fades out]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we're bringing you the latest updates from the music world. I'm your host, and today we're coming to you live from Lollapalooza 2026. We just caught up with the talented Stella Lefty, who's been making waves with her hit song "Boston". Stella, thanks for taking the time to chat with us backstage.
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: So, Stella, let's dive right in. Your song "Boston" just reached No. 3 on the Billboard Hot 100 chart. How does it feel to have achieved that milestone?
Stella Lefty: [laughs] I was in denial at first. I didn't believe it, and I didn't want to look. But when I finally saw it, I was like, "OK, this is crazy!" Being on the same chart as Taylor Swift and Ella Langley is just surreal.
Host: That's amazing. And speaking of new music, can you tell us a bit about your upcoming album, 'Long Way Home'?
Stella Lefty: Yeah, 'Long Way Home' is all about the journey of coming back to where it all started. It's about the trial and error of being an artist, making songs that you love and don't love, and figuring it out along the way. We tried to make it feel as Chicago as possible, so you'll have to listen to find out what that means.
Host: We can't wait to hear it. Thanks for sharing that with us, Stella. And to our listeners, stay tuned for more updates from Lollapalooza 2026.
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: That's all for now. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next one.
